payload.title: File:Leonardo mummified brachylophosaurus.jpg
payload.description_html: From the permanent collection of The Judith River Foundation, Leonardo, a fully articulated and partially mummified skeleton of a subadult brachylophosaur, is currently on loan to The Children’s Museum of Indianapolis. The fossil is 77 million years old and was discovered in Montana in 2000.
